claims.text: Adding a hidden layer to differentiable classifier architectures enables concurrent adversarial optimization for fairness and accuracy.
The framework provides a method to quantify the tradeoff between fairness and accuracy.

evidence.description: Given any existing differentiable classifier, we make only slight adjustments to the architecture including adding a new hidden layer, in order to enable the concurrent adversarial optimization for fairness and accuracy.
Our framework provides one way to quantify the tradeoff between fairness and accuracy

methodologies.name: One-Network Adversarial Fairness
methodologies.description: Modifying existing differentiable classifiers by adding a hidden layer to enable concurrent adversarial optimization for accuracy and fairness.
